meta.name: muapi-one-shot-video
meta.description: Generate a single continuous cinematic shot video — no cuts, one seamless flowing scene with dramatic lighting and motion.

copy.tagline: 生成一段电影级单镜头连续视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成无剪辑、有电影感的单镜头视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate a cinematic one-shot video with seamless flow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a seamless, cinematic single-shot video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你描述的场景、风格、时长和画面比例，生成一段连续不剪辑的电影感视频。如果提供参考图，还能让视频内容与图片保持一致。
howto.when: 当你提到“一镜到底”、“单次拍摄”、“连续视频”等关键词，或要求生成一段无剪辑的连续镜头视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段一镜到底的视频：厨师在米其林厨房里摆盘。
say.note: Claude 会调用视频生成工具，输出一段连续镜头。

say.text: 用这张参考图，生成一段9:16竖屏、5秒的连续视频，风格为黑色电影。
say.note: Claude 会基于参考图生成指定时长和比例的连续镜头。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a single continuous cinematic shot video based on your description of scene, style, duration, and aspect ratio. If a reference image is provided, the video will be anchored to that subject or scene.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "one shot video", "single take", "continuous video", or ask to generate a seamless, uncut cinematic shot.

say_en.text: Generate a one-shot video of a chef plating food in a moody Michelin-star kitchen.
say_en.note: Claude will call the video generation tool and output a continuous shot.

say_en.text: Using this reference image, create a 9:16 vertical 5-second continuous video in noir style.
